brand_identity.name: Caro
brand_identity.tone: Direct, confident, premium, UK industry voice
brand_identity.core_aesthetic: Warm premium UK automotive/fintech feel. Rich layering, spotlight/featured sections, depth, editorial layouts, refined data-dense but beautiful dashboards, and immersive scroll sections.

headings.usage: Use for all H1-H4 headings. Make H1 highly expressive (text-5xl to text-6xl+).

body.usage: Use for all UI text, paragraphs, buttons, and form inputs. Clean and legible.

homepage.hero: Immersive hero section overlaying a premium London street or SUV image. Use a solid search bar at the bottom with proper dropdowns. Dropdowns MUST have a solid white background (bg-card) with elevated z-index (z-50) and shadow (shadow-xl) to fix the transparent bug.
homepage.featured_collections: Bento-style grids for curated collections (e.g., Top-rated, Electric, Under £250/wk, Wheelchair-accessible). Do not use flat uniform grids. Overlap elements slightly for depth.
homepage.scroll_storytelling: Full-height (min-h-screen) scrolling sections for 'How renting works' and 'How listing works'. Alternate sides for text and imagery. Use Framer Motion for scroll-triggered fades and parallax. No accordions.

vehicle_detail.gallery: Hero area split into a main 16:9 image and a 2x2 grid of smaller interior/exterior shots.
vehicle_detail.content: Two-column layout. Left column (70%): full specs, 360/video embed area, anonymized operator info, reviews, and an Airbnb-style full-width map block showing the pickup zone. Right column (30%): Sticky all-in cost panel, calculated breakdown, min-max budget ranges, and primary CTA.

dashboards.general: Data-dense, professional, calculated breakdown. Use clean, rounded cards (max 8px radius). Even in logged-out/demo states, populate with beautiful mock data (charts, transaction lists).

components.header_account_menu: Turo/Splend style. A solid, pristine popover triggered by 'Menu / Profile' icon. Links: Log in as customer, Log in as operator, Register interest, Get help, Legal. Must have pure white background, border-border, shadow-lg.
components.search_filters: Include a robust price range slider for minimum/maximum budget. Use solid background Select/Dropdown menus.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or slightly rounded (rounded-md). Use the primary emerald color for high-intent actions.
components.multi_step_form: For the 'apply' process. Use a clear progress indicator, large accessible inputs, and soft micro-interactions.

motion.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth scrolling to give the marketing pages a premium 'momentum' feel.
motion.interactions: Hover states on vehicle cards should gently scale up the image (scale-105) and translate the card slightly up (-translate-y-1) with a soft shadow.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL FIX: Overwrite the shadcn UI root CSS variables with the provided HSL values to ensure pure white (#FFFFFF) backgrounds for popovers, dropdowns, and cards. Apply `bg-background` or `bg-card` classes explicitly on SelectContent, DropdownMenuContent, etc., with z-[100] to fix the transparency bug.
Implement Cabinet Grotesk for headings and Satoshi for body text.
Build the 'How it works' sections as scroll-driven narrative pages instead of accordions.
On the Vehicle Detail Page, build a sticky sidebar (using sticky top-24) for the booking/cost calculator.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Use Lucide-react icons for UI elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Create depth with layered elements and z-index hierarchy.
Use 2-3x more spacing than usual. Cramped designs look cheap.
Never use pure black; use the designated dark slate/foreground color.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, popovers, or floating headers.
Ensure hover states and micro-interactions on all buttons and cards.
Use the exact image URLs provided in the media section; do not use placeholders.
